notes.title: Summer Development Update from Drinkbox Studios
notes.content:
Hey! How’s it going?  

Eating well? Sleeping in? Folding clothes? 

That’s so great to hear.



- Oh, us? Nah, we haven’t been up to much. 

Well, except for all the work we’ve put into our new game Blighted. Check it out!



As you know, we announced Blighted back in June as part of Summer Game Fest 2025, and we’ve been hard at work on it since. (Thanks for wishlisting it, by the way. It really does help 🙏)



We don’t want to spoil too much, buuuut we’ve added a TON of enemies to the game, and are still adding more! Each of them deadly in their own weird and freaky little way.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcGirw8Xgso8NdeflBw5tE3v9twKbLroA8soxm1P_mNAdGmdkZ5C9_bJyPOj2GZDyuTPcmwgHdYx6G8IqpUKWSmOjzHdpvdjUPkOhc04Oza7_x-x0lJfhnmYhKJKRH3fZxsfhy88A?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"]

It’s hard to believe but we actually built out an early version of the entire game as part of an internal-alpha milestone! And right now we’re in the middle of tearing it all up, choosing the best bits, adding juicy challenges and putting it all back together again.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcB7WNc_ID7rJSXKc1JFCllZP1WG7931zeX0LzGzcbE39r41XNQEUhoFPC5fPW3r2ME0EwTgIr5yNacpA3YQVbiCgsbbN0d3VURjWpuC0UxvbzdqJl4Kz1GFr88HvST0So6Vln-3Q?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"]

Now, it might sound like we don’t have much left to do, but that couldn’t be further from the truth! We’re still fine tuning the gameplay and combat loop to go beyond the standard we’ve established in any of our other games thus far. Blight is getting deadlier, and gnarlier too. Our programmers are working all sorts of technical magic to make Blighted shine, ooze and wriggle. And every new object in the game is another opportunity for our artists to draw up a fresh nightmarish creation to populate the growing world. And Jim Guthrie is still sending us tracks that put shivers down our spines in all of the best ways.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdS_wktGXW5cZQpDDjZt3wW6YyMfT8JOuDx3nTPCVZ09bmpu-1zeVOE7mKbCfz3RxLrI_0weblRZDYIhxJnt5lL6L0ZvElUxzM4LaMA6zo8hz-WDj0LxC1uAYI-FOXRAFfLqGL8vg?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"]



We're also prepping the soundtrack from Tales from Space: Mutant Blobs Attack to be released on Steam very soon! As one of our first major releases, Mutant Blobs Attack will always hold a special place in our ears - because the soundtrack by Peter Chapman and Shaun Hatton is SO GOOD. If you ever need a shot of caffeine directly into your earlobes, load up this soundtrack, sit back, and get back up again because your toes will not stop tapping.

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcLSBqlew1oYLAN1HV9oezPGECMjlVP1r4NB60tS529tzdSypMl_0bJVfLRJZz_hjtCOLy1nLpgeY7kSNurU6ldRLcLNQ3oz2_pudPhbuFnB3ZoxyzqBpNN0xonYoR_d-smP7VDZQ?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"]

On the more human side, we recently took the team out to get their quarterly quota of exercise by running, jumping, dodging, ducking, dipping, diving, dodging, throwing, shooting (basketball), shooting (gun) and yelling with Activate. We then gathered for our biggest team photo to date!! (we’re still missing an international co-worker or two, but we’ll get them one day!)

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeGWP9bjPXc4TEF92lcb1cSn1rR7NMcd0_by5CbjprrIM9GQYpW25AntKL0Bb19xy4CZGFkhEORf8QcQ8pXc_6JxiaBuTCzExVvUUCiAWpYA4fbJlkbls86-kz4bFPP_1RkQSmY?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"]



Huh. Turns out we have in fact been ‘up to much’! Sorry for all the yapping. As a thank you for listening, we’ve put all of our games on sale on Steam!



Catch you later!

The Drinkbox Team

notes.title: Happy Holidays from Drinkbox Studios
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/002999d6b6cc90990cfb62b28377ed799cf7a452.png

Happy Holidays! 2023 was a relatively quiet year for us as we’ve been heads-down, working on some new ideas… but we still wanted to share some highlights from the past year!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/ba07ac9e7634dbde752899bf0618bf198c826a59.png

In January we released a free update for Nobody Saves the World which featured Magic Jimmy’s Impossible Dungeon and a new unlockable Dinosaur form. We were overwhelmed with the positive response to this update and loved seeing photos of your statue gardens!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/8f6eee9b4374c296186f877c15cbb034520008e2.jpg

This year we added some new members to our team including 3D Technical Artist Greg and Junior Programmer Fred. We also welcomed back Animator and Artist Matheus who worked with us on Nobody Saves the World!

Speaking of our team, here are some of their favourite games played in 2023:

 Cass: Nioh, Dragon's Dogma, Remnant 2
 Fred: Paradise Marsh, Risk of Rain Returns, Plate Up
 Gabby: Zelda TOTK, Baldur’s Gate 3, Dave the Diver, Slay the Princess
 Graham: Baldur's Gate 3, Zelda TOTK, Mario Wonder
 Greg: Lethal Company
 Ian: Time Crisis 4, Cobalt Core, Kane & Lynch 2: Dog Days
 Josh: Hi-Fi Rush, Mario Wonder
 Matheus: Alan Wake 2, Spider-man 2, Elden Ring
 Mau: Mario Wonder, Zelda TOTK, Metroid Prime
 Mike: Baldur's Gate 3, Armored Core VI, Cyberpunk 2077
 Ryan: Dungeons & Dragons (pen and paper)
 Steele: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades, Victoria 3, RimWorld
 Vlad: Counter-Strike 2, Squad, Spider-Man 2, Armored Core VI


https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/45fbd48875f82292a86d5a067a18e4a8b09a6161.png

Here are some highlights from the past year:

🥇 Nobody Saves the World was nominated for a bunch of awards, including the Canadian Screen Awards, Canadian Game Awards, and Webby Awards. We didn’t win any of these, buuuuut…

🏆 Jim Guthrie won the Screen Composers Guild of Canada award for “Best Original Score for Games and Interactive Media” for the Nobody Saves the World soundtrack!

💿 Jim also released the Nobody Saves the World soundtrack on a beautiful double vinyl

🐓 We teamed up with The Yetee to release new Nobody Saves the World and Guacamelee merch, including this very good spinning pollo pin

💖 We partnered with Limited Run Games to release physical versions of Nobody Saves the World, Severed, and Mutant Blobs Attack (which sold out almost immediately!)

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/56605bcb2d046e74eeb5fd36d2515cf140f33bd5.jpg

Over this past year we’ve been busy prototyping new stuff, playing with new ideas and styles. We’ve landed on something the whole team is very excited about, something completely new to us that we hope you’ll be excited about too.

We can’t wait to share more when we can, but in the meantime here’s a lil sneaky peek ^

Consider joining our discord to keep updated on the latest news about all our games (including this new one)

- - - 

Thank you for all your support over this past year! We really couldn’t have done it without you and appreciate your support.

Happy Holidays, 
Signed, Matthew DrinkBox

notes.title: Our new game Nobody Saves the World is OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
Hi friends! We are beyond excited to announce that our brand new game Nobody Saves The World is OUT NOW!!

Check out the launch trailer here: 
[previewyoutube=H_E1RhtzDHM;full][/previewyoutube]  

To celebrate its launch we’ve put the game on sale for 10% OFF for a limited time:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432050/Nobody_Saves_the_World/ 

Here’s what people are saying about the game so far:


 “After finishing Nobody Saves the World, I went right back to it… When a game is this much frictionless fun, it's hard to resist.” 9 – Gamespot
 “Nobody Saves the World kept me enthralled from start to finish.” 8.25 – Game Informer
 “...A wonderfully technical game that offers the freedom to let you discover the quality of its craft in your own time.” 80 – PC Gamer
 “Drinkbox's latest is as polished and colourful as you might expect - and it's as generous too. I had fun. I am still having fun.” RECOMMENDED – Eurogamer

We’ll have even more Nobody Saves the World surprises coming in the next few months that we can’t wait to share with you 👀 Join our Discord to keep up to date with NSTW news!

THANK YOU! We’re excited to finally share this game after ~3 years years of working on it. This is the biggest game our studio has made to date and was made possible through the 13+ years of experience we've gained working together as a team, and the generous support and enthusiastic feedback provided by our community during the course of development. We hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it!

2021 was an eventful year for us, and we wanted to take a moment to reflect on it and share some highlights.

notes.title: DrinkBox Studios 2020 Year in Review
notes.content:
Happy Holidays! 

Wow… 2020 sure was a year, huh? 😅 Despite, well you know *gestures broadly*, we’re very fortunate to have had a pretty good year at DrinkBox and wanted to take some time to look back, reflect on the year, and share some highlights.

When COVID-19 hit back in March, the city of Toronto went into full lockdown and the whole DrinkBox team transitioned to working remotely from home. There was definitely an adjustment period as we set up our respective home offices, switched to using Discord for our daily stand ups and meetings, and got used to our new co-workers -- ie. our cats and dogs and plants, who were especially excited about this working-from-home we were all doing. We’ve since settled into a nice flow with the whole team working together remotely, and now we have a new Friday night ritual of playing games together via Discord, which is a nice thing to come out of this whole lockdown thing.

Speaking of which, here are some of our team’s favourite games they played in 2020:


 Cass: Spelunky 2
 Gabby: Hades
 Graham: Crosscode
 Ian: Devil May Cry 5
 Josh: Rocket League
 Kaitlin: Animal Crossing New Horizons
 Mayuran: Hades, Factorio
 Mike: Hades, Demon's Souls remake
 Steph: Astro’s Playroom


https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/e09cc99d67cef11765527075417eb776b263d82c.jpg

While we didn’t have any new releases in 2020 ourselves, we did have some exciting Guacamelee! news to come out of this year: 


 The Guacamelee! One Two Punch Collection was released in Europe!
 Juan made a cameo in Bounty Battle, along with several other indie game protagonists
 NOW Magazine named Guacamelee! one of their Top 10 Toronto-made Games (a lot of great games are made in Toronto so we’re very honoured!!)
 We partnered with Ship to Shore to create TWO vinyl records for both Guacamelee! and Guacamelee! 2! You can pre-order them both here


https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/e4592e96848a07f6104e840717cb651c22887994.jpg

We also teased our upcoming unannounced game which we’ve been working hard on over this past year. It’s a brand new IP we’re very excited for, and can’t wait to share more about it with you in 2021 👀

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/6ded4ab0ad2ca0444f7df75638012b1c442135aa.gif

To help us develop this brand new game we’re working on, we added 2 new people to the DrinkBox team, including Josh Davis our QA Tester and Kaitlin Smith our Associate Producer!  

Hey actually, did you know we’re currently hiring for 2 additional roles including Senior Programmer and Game Tester? If you’re interested in applying check out the job listings here. We’d love to have you on the team!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/be33a602d76a0c292d38a8c556623ad086f43b4d.jpg

Thanks for all your support in 2020. We hope you’re doing well and continuing to stay safe and that 2021 will be a much better year for everyone.

Happy Holidays, from your pals at DrinkBox studios

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/9b28e0ecdff02c966e55e6359c42274a00944e0c.jpg

By the way, all of our games are on sale for up to 80% OFF during the Holiday! These are the steepest discounts we do all year, so there’s never been a better time to pick up our games:

notes.content:
Happy holidays! 2019 was an eventful year for us, and we wanted to take some time to reflect on our past year and share some highlights. 

We brought a lot of our games to new platforms this year including:

 Guacamelee 2! on Xbox One and Windows 10
 Mutant Blobs Attack to the Nintendo Switch
 A physical edition of Guacamelee! 1+2 Punch for Nintendo Switch and PS4 (with @LeadmanGames)
 Physical editions of both Guacamelee! and Mutant Blobs Attack for PS Vita (with @LimitedRunGames)


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/8e3af5507a6bb0a4db78e0f5a08a0f249338dca2.jpg

This year we travelled to a few places including the Game Developers Conference in San Francisco, as well as Spain where Cuxo did a concept art workshop with Nintendo for their Day of the Dead festivities.

At Awesome Games Done Quick 2019  we watched @TheBlacktastic do an excellent Guacamelee! 2 speedrun which was so exciting it ground production in our office to a halt!

This year we welcomed back Steele to help us out on production on our new projects, as well as Gabby (that’s me!) to the DrinkBox team.

Juan made an appearance as a playable character in Riverbond and will be a guest character in Indivisible. We’re super excited to see him in two of our favourite games and can’t wait to play!

We’re thrilled to announce that Guacamelee! 2 will launch for Steam on August 21st for $19.99 USD. Check out the new launch trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Y5n_oHsR9Q

The original Guacamelee! launched in April of 2013. It’s now over five years later and the game still stands as the definitive Mexican-Folklore-Inspired-Luchador-Platform-Brawler-Metroidvania! How do we top that?

More Chicken!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/e107c62c6b90164fd67dcd57167919b726454549.jpg

The power of the pollo reigns supreme throughout Guacamelee! 2.

Small tunnel to traverse? Turn into a chicken and strut right on through.

Giant purple block in your way? Pollo Shot and smash that bad boy to bits.

Wait… what’s that? An orange block? Smash it with an expertly executed Pollo Slide.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/1d115387a9491c838d13afc0e874e5725b4d9ac1.png

Pollo Shot against bouncy walls and ricochet yourself a rapid path to freedom.

Experience the full glory of Pollo Glide by using air currents to reach unprecedented heights!

But what if the entire fabric of the Mexiverse is at risk of collapsing in on itself? No problem. Stumble upon a secret society of prophetic chickens and prove your worth. Could JUAN be the fabled CHICKEN-MAN!?

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/0bce691e898948f37c3687e96601b54c29aee385.jpg

As you can well imagine, these new chicken moves aren’t just for busting your way into exotic new locations. Pollo combat is frantic, furious and fabulous.

In fact, there’s so much new chicken gameplay and content in Guacamelee! 2 that we embedded a genre-busting Pollovania completely inside of the main story’s Metroidvania. The only such game in existence as of the writing of this post… probably.

How to Train Your Luchador

As we were making Guacamelee! 2, it occurred to us that all of the new abilities we were adding would require extensive training for players to properly master. So, we recruited a batch of mostly competent and somewhat knowledgeable characters to fill the role.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/e0b17ea3f222934b6541b50cf8c0f812995cba4f.jpg

As players progress through the world of Guacamelee! 2, they’ll encounter ability trainers. Each of these trainers has a specialty that they focus on. Complete trainer challenges and they’ll hook you up with powerful upgrades and cool new abilities.

Climb to the peak of fitness with Doña Chamoya or sharpen your beak under the tutelage of Rooster Ramírez. Upgrade your grappling moves with Coscorrona or decipher Uay Coco’s instructions to punch with explosive force!

However, if you really want to fight with finesse, visit Flame Face in one of his many tequila bar franchises and go toe-to-toe against punching Poncho (don’t hold back, he’s paid well for the job).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/d3c50b146d9885652f28744bc7b945d750cb4804.jpg

A Bigger Game than Ever Before

Guacamelee! 2 is an epic adventure that can be experienced alone or co-operatively with three of your closest amigos. Explore hundreds of new platforming and combat challenges. New abilities such as Eagle Boost, Rocket Kick, GOOOTCHA! and more add to Juan’s awesome arsenal of luchador moves. Upgrade your pollo form with Pollo Shot, Pollo Slide and a plethora of new chicken abilities (some secret, some not so secret). Select strategically from dozens of new skill upgrades to maximize your lucha potential.

So how did we plan to squeeze all of this into a game the size of Guacamelee! ? We didn’t! Thanks to our poor planning, we were forced to create a much larger game than the original. You can expect a bigger, badder world, with all sorts of interesting nooks and crannies to explore and conquer.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/3dcb382dad20f883d276f4d660c1fc8a46072f13.jpg

We’ve worked extremely hard on the game over the past two years, and we’re super hyped that people will finally be able to experience Guacamelee! 2 so soon. Please feel free to ask any questions you have in the comments below, and we will try to answer them the best we can!

Oh... and please Wishlist us! (if you wish)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/534550/Guacamelee_2/

notes.title: Multiplayer Fixes! New DrinkBox workshop skins!! Sale!!!
notes.content:
Hey there Steam,
We’d like to tell you about a long-brewing update we’ve just put up that provides a few minor fixes, plus a dab of bonus content. Feast your eyes on the sumptuous changelist below:

Enhancements to the costume creator: Instead of custom skins always changing appearance to Juan/Tostada while in Intenso mode, you can now specify whether they Intenso-fy as J/T or just as a gleaming version of the custom skin. You can also turn off the glow that appears around them while in the opposite dimension, which is handy if the skin has changed your character’s silhouette so that it wouldn't match the normal glow shape.
Players who had an issue where their computer would run the game super-too-fast should hopefully now find that to be resolved. Please email us at support AT drinkboxstudios DOT com if you still see anything similar cropping up post-patch.
Some changes to better support the new 3- and 4-player mode, as well as miscellaneous other bug fixes. For more detail, see the  full changelist
And the fun part: play as your favourite NPC! We’ve added to the Workshop for both Guac STCE and Gold Edition custom skins to let you play as X’Tabay, Uay Chivo, Flameface or Jaguar Javier. Steam user Mujizik worked with us to create these lavishly animated reskins, and they’re free to download as of today.

Finally, we’re having a sale! Guacamelee (STCE, Gold and the Complete bundle) will be 80% off on Steam for the next week! Tell all your Guac-deprived friends. :juan:

notes.title: 4-Player mode is now LIVE! Plus: FINAL WEEK of loyalty discount (86%-OFF)!!
notes.content:
Hello Steam users!

4-PLAYER LOCAL CO-OP NOW LIVE!! 

http://i.imgur.com/pzQYP2P.jpg

 The Guacamelee! STCE 4-player co-op update is now out of beta and LIVE on Steam! 

Many new fixes & features have been integrated, with a particular emphasis on co-op improvements.  The biggest single change is the new 4 player local co-op mode.  A full change list is available here.

 LOYALTY DISCOUNT – FINAL WEEK, 86%-OFF

http://i.imgur.com/m4vgdNo.jpg

Due to a configuration problem, the 86%-off loyalty discount offered last week as part of the Halloween sale was available to some, but not all eligible users.  We believe this issue is now fixed, and the discount has been extended for an extra week!
 
Also: Please note that the Guacamelee! STCE loyalty discount WILL BE DISCONTINUED on November 10th.   If you’re a Guac Gold owner and you’ve been thinking of upgrading STCE, this week is your last chance to do so at a deeply discounted price.

We hope you like the update!

notes.title: New 4-Player Beta, 86% Halloween Sale loyalty discount!!
notes.content:
Greetings Steam community!

NEW 4-PLAYER LOCAL CO-OP - NOW IN BETA

http://i.imgur.com/diVwMPv.jpg

Guac STCE - 4-player stream (alpha version).

A free new beta of Guacamelee! STCE featuring many improvements to local co-op - including newly added support for up to 4 players  - is now available!  To try it out you’ll need to opt in to the Beta, via 'Properties' -> 'BETAS' -> 'Beta - co-op update'. 

A comprehensive list of changes included in the Beta is available
here.

 LOYALTY DISCOUNT UPDATE 

http://i.imgur.com/dkBRVUT.jpg 

For the duration of the Halloween sale, Guacamelee! STCE will be on sale at an extra 20% off.  This discount will be applied in combination with the existing Guacamelee! Gold-owner loyalty discount of 66%, for a total loyalty discount of 86% for Guac Gold owners.

Finally an important note: The loyalty discount will be ending soon - likely some time in November.  Get it while you still can!!
